git_message: Add Oja Kind-A development convergence probe (D083 sub-decision 3 / D085 a) in scripts/: standalone diagnostic, no GA/fitness. Answers the fork - does strength-only support-frozen plasticity converge? Instrumented for what-it-converged-to: E-decode (level-1) + context-decode (level-2), so 'converged but level-2-blind' is measured not assumed. Enforces Kind-A support-freeze invariant in code. Oja update + invariant unit-verified; Brian2 write-back (_reload_W) and convergence hyperparameters need validation on first real run
notes: D083/D085: does Kind-A Oja development converge? + what does it converge to?
